verdicts.reason: A: the quote is tiny at this banner size. The bold attribution runs under it almost to the bottom edge, so the vertical spacing is cramped. The quote mark is crammed into the top-left corner, and the SOLSTICE logo is missing. B: it reads left to right in three clear columns (quote mark, quote, attribution, product), and the quote is larger and more legible. Flaws: the 3-line quote nearly touches the top and bottom edges. The attribution is as heavy as the quote, which weakens the hierarchy. The logo is dropped and the product bottle is small.
